issues.issue: Did the Federal Court err in its evidentiary standard for proving infringement under s. 6 of the PMNOC Regulations?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants argue Federal Court applied too high a standard and failed to recognize initial burden on Teva to put allegations into play.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents argue Federal Court correctly applied balance of probabilities and no initial burden on Teva for non-infringement.
issues.result_text: No palpable and overriding error in finding appellants' testing unreliable and no proof of infringement.

issues.issue: Should the Federal Court have drawn an adverse inference against Teva for not producing tablets for testing?
issues.applicant_position: Appellants argue adverse inference should be drawn against Teva for not producing tablets.
issues.respondent_position: Respondents argue production not required under s. 6(7) and appellants better equipped to make compound for testing.
issues.result_text: Appellants failed to show palpable and overriding error on adverse inference point.
